items.title: Register as job-seeking with the employment agency
items.action: Register as job-seeking (arbeitsuchend melden) with the Agentur für Arbeit immediately.
items.consequence: You may face a reduction of unemployment benefit (Sperrzeit) if you delay registering.
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.

items.title: Decide on filing a lawsuit against the dismissal
items.action: Decide whether to file a lawsuit (Kündigungsschutzklage) against this dismissal at the labour court (Arbeitsgericht) by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the dismissal becomes legally effective and can no longer be challenged in court.

data.title: Notice of termination (Kündigung) from Weingut Musterreben KG
data.summary: Weingut Musterreben KG, Ute Beispielberger's employer, gives ordinary notice of termination effective 31 January 2027 because the bottle sales department is being outsourced to a wholesaler. The letter was handed over in person on 18 November 2026, and notes that a lawsuit against the dismissal must be filed at the labour court within three weeks of receipt.
data.explanation: Your employer has terminated your employment for operational reasons (closure of the sales department), effective 31 January 2027, following the statutory notice period. You should register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit right away to avoid a cut in unemployment benefits. You also have the choice to challenge this dismissal in court (Kündigungsschutzklage); the app shows the deadline for this by which such a lawsuit would need to be filed at the labour court. If you decide not to act by then, the dismissal becomes final. Consider getting advice from a lawyer or your local Arbeitsgericht's advice service, since employment law deadlines are strict.
